Financing an Ather: options and documents

Most of our customers buy on finance, and approval is usually quick. Here is how Ather's Flexipay scheme and our partner lenders work, what interest to expect, and the documents that make approval fastest.

Updated 12 November 2026 · 2 min read · Pillai Auto, authorised Ather dealer

On this page

  1. Ather Flexipay
  2. Other lenders
  3. Documents to bring
  4. Make approval quicker
  5. Look at the total, not just the EMI

Ather Flexipay

Ather's Flexipay finance offers zero down payment, simplified approval and tenures up to five years. Ather advertises interest from 3.99% on the 450 and Rizta and from 5.75% on the Konarc, with Konarc EMIs from ₹1,964 a month and Rizta EMIs from about ₹2,235. Actual rates depend on the lender, your credit profile, the tenure and the down payment.

Other lenders

We also work with banks and NBFCs. Our finance desk compares the offers you qualify for and lays them side by side — interest rate, processing fee, total payable — so you can choose on the full cost, not just the EMI.

Documents to bring

ForTypical documents
Identity and addressAadhaar, PAN card
SalariedLatest salary slips, bank statements for recent months
Self-employedBank statements, recent income-tax returns or business proof
EveryonePassport-size photos, an active mobile number linked to your bank

Lenders vary; we tell you exactly what your chosen lender needs before you visit.

Make approval quicker

  • Check your credit score beforehand.
  • Bring complete documents in one visit.
  • Choose a tenure that keeps the EMI comfortable — a longer tenure lowers the EMI but raises total interest.
  • Combine finance with an exchange of your old scooter to reduce the loan amount.

Try different amounts in our EMI calculator.

Look at the total, not just the EMI

A longer tenure always looks cheaper per month. As an illustration, a ₹1,20,000 loan at 9% interest:

TenureMonthly EMITotal repaid
36 months≈ ₹3,816≈ ₹1,37,400
60 months≈ ₹2,491≈ ₹1,49,500

The five-year loan costs about ₹12,000 more overall. Choose the shortest tenure whose EMI you are comfortable with — and compare it with the petrol you will stop buying.

Questions we get asked

Ather's Flexipay scheme offers zero down payment options, subject to lender approval.

Ather advertises rates from 3.99% on the 450 and Rizta and from 5.75% on the Konarc. Your actual rate depends on the lender and your credit profile.

With complete documents, approvals often come through the same day.
